verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of explicit sampling controls (e.g., trace sampling rates, log sampling) or configurable retention tiers; only generic pricing/ingest tier info (100GB free) is shown. Community reports reinforce this gap—customers describe being surprised by default-enabled log/JFR collection driving up ingest costs, and support being unable to help them 'filter irrelevant data' or manage volume deliberately (new-relic-comm-1, new-relic-comm-3, new-relic-comm-5).
